item.text: The workspace is empty apart from evaluation logs, so I’m building the artifact from scratch. I’ll keep each browser file self-contained behind browser globals, with the elevator scheduler isolated so the Node tests can exercise it without Three.js.

I’m adding the simulated clock, persistent worker/visitor pool, action dispatch, collision/seat handling, and HUD next.
